{{Quote|I'm back home after touring with my band, the Dewback Ramblers. You know us? -- Well, never mind.|[[Blerx Tango]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
The '''Dewback Ramblers''' were a [[Band/Legends|band]] led by [[Blerx Tango]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Blerx-tango.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Blerx Tango]], leader of the Dewback Ramblers.]]
{{Quote|I hope this is the last excitement the Dewback Ramblers see for a while.|Blerx Tango, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Band/Legends|band]] was based out of the [[Lucky Star (Mos Entha)|Lucky Star]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]]. The band was led by the [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] player [[Blerx Tango]], and staffed by three other members. The members consisted of a [[slitherhorn]] player named [[Jakko Mixon]], an [[Ommni box/Legends|ommni box]] player named [[Mellaw Doowon]], and a [[mandoviol]] player named [[Baze Joz]].<ref name="SWG:BT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> three of the members got in trouble, including with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and had to be rescued by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] employed by Blerx.<ref name="SWG:BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dewback Ramblers appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
